name: SI:7 (Stormwind City)
summary: In Old Town, SI:7 watches for threats to Stormwind from a fortified stone manor. Master Mathias Shaw directs the kingdom’s intelligence service from behind its heavy doors.

sections.title: Heart of the Kingdom's Espionage
sections.body:
In Old Town, SI:7 works from a fortified stone manor. From the street, it could pass for an ordinary home or military barracks. Master Mathias Shaw directs Stormwind Intelligence, Section 7. Its agents gather intelligence, watch suspected threats and carry out secret operations to guard the kingdom from subversion.

The city guard patrols Stormwind’s streets, while the Royal Guard protects Stormwind Keep. SI:7 trains handlers and sends covert agents against foreign enemies, saboteurs and unrest within the kingdom.

sections.title: A Watchful Eye on the Shadows
sections.body:
Scouts hidden across human lands send their reports to SI:7’s headquarters. Its agents watch the turmoil caused by the Defias Brotherhood in Westfall and Duskwood, while King Varian Wrynn remains missing.

In cellars and training rooms lined with weapons, operatives hone lethal techniques. Then they receive assignments to counter threats before those threats reach the boy-king’s throne room.

faq.answer: SI:7 means Stormwind Intelligence, Section 7. It is the Crown of Stormwind’s agency for covert espionage, reconnaissance and assassination.

aliases: who is the leader of si7
faq.answer: Master Mathias Shaw leads SI:7 from its headquarters. He oversees its field assignments, intelligence networks and reconnaissance for the crown.

faq.q: Where in the city is this building located?
faq.answer: SI:7’s headquarters stands in Old Town, along the district’s southeastern edge near the canal and training yards.

faq.q: Why is SI:7 so interested in Westfall?
faq.answer: SI:7 watches for subversive activity across Stormwind’s territories. The Defias Brotherhood is the realm’s most dangerous insurrection.

angles.text: As an Alliance rogue, you can find advanced training, poison supplies and secret assignments from Spymaster Mathias Shaw at SI:7.
As an Alliance member, you can count on SI:7’s intelligence network to provide the military with reconnaissance against threats to the throne.
